name: Set-theoretic measurable coloring meets distributed local algorithms
summary: Efficient local algorithms for colouring networks were shown to translate into measurable colourings of infinite graphs, so thresholds in descriptive set theory and in distributed computing classify the same problems.

name: Non-rationality of cubic fourfolds attacked via mirror-symmetry-inspired Hodge atoms
summary: Curve counts on a fourfold, an idea inspired by mirror symmetry, split its Hodge structure into atoms and show that degree-3 five-variable equations cannot be parametrised.

name: Machine learning guides conjectures in knot theory and representation theory
summary: Supervised learning and saliency analysis pointed human mathematicians to a relation between signature and geometric invariants of knots and to a candidate recipe for Kazhdan-Lusztig polynomials.

name: Apery-style irrationality via analytic continuation of power series
summary: Apery's 1978 method was generalised by extending convergence discs of the relevant power series, giving irrationality proofs for values such as L(2) and an infinite family of zeta-like sums.

name: AlphaTensor: reinforcement learning for matrix multiplication algorithms
summary: Matrix multiplication was cast as a single-player tensor decomposition game solved by AlphaGo-style training, and conventional search then refined its mod-2 algorithms within days.

name: Integer distance sets via the determinant method
summary: Lifting planar integer-distance sets into higher dimensions and applying the determinant method showed that all but a sparse subset of a large set lies on a line or circle.

name: Kakeya sets in three dimensions
summary: A volume estimate for unions of convex sets obtained from incidence geometry and multi-scale arguments settles the Kakeya set conjecture in R^3.
